functionDeclarations.name: cutlass_status
functionDeclarations.description: State of Cutlass: project, ffmpeg, who holds the edit lock. Call first.

functionDeclarations.name: cutlass_capabilities
functionDeclarations.description: Export presets, qualities, transition kinds, title anchors, edit modes and limits of this build and ffmpeg.

functionDeclarations.name: cutlass_acquire_lock
functionDeclarations.description: Take the edit lock before any change. The user sees your name and reason.

agentName.description: Your name as the user should see it.

reason.description: What you are about to do, in a few words.

waitMs.description: Wait this long (at most 120000) when the user or another agent is busy.

leaseSeconds.description: Lease length, 15 to the configured maximum; renewed by every call you make.

functionDeclarations.name: cutlass_renew_lock
functionDeclarations.description: Renew your lease during a long pause. Every other call renews it as well.

functionDeclarations.name: cutlass_release_lock
functionDeclarations.description: Give the project back to the user. Always call when done.

functionDeclarations.name: cutlass_get_lock
functionDeclarations.description: Who holds the edit lock, its phase and lease.

functionDeclarations.name: cutlass_get_project
functionDeclarations.description: Timeline as JSON: tracks, clips (ids, frames, source times), transitions, markers, media.

from.description: Only clips ending after this frame.

to.description: Only clips starting before this frame.

functionDeclarations.name: cutlass_describe_project
functionDeclarations.description: Short text overview of the timeline; cheaper than get_project.

from.description: Only clips ending after this frame.

to.description: Only clips starting before this frame.
